description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class which implements the LogNode interface. It filters log messages, passing only the message content to the next LogNode in the chain, and discards metadata like priority, tag, and Throwable.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log node filter that outputs only log messages, omitting metadata like priority, tag, etc.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that accepts the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters log entries to pass only the message part to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
